194:t_3:52.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ノノ$$ is an android, but her memories of the past are hazy.」

194:t_3:53.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Apparently $$ノノリリ$$ is the space pilot she idolizes.」

194:t_3:54.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's right! $$ノノリリ$$ is a pure, virtuous, beautiful girl who fought with humanity's future on her shoulders!」

194:t_3:55.en:
$$ノノ$$
「She has long, beautiful hair, a gorgeous body, and the smile of a holy mother... She's the very symbol of humanity's hope!」

194:t_3:56.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Sh-she's nothing like me... Sad as that is...」

194:t_3:57.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Well!? Now you know your place!」

194:t_3:58.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Hey... You're ignoring your own clumsiness and going too far.」

194:t_3:60.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「The Princess is right. $$ノノ$$, you're overreacting to $$ノリコ$$ just because your names are similar.」

194:t_3:61.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$カシオ$$ says $$ガンバスター$$ and our $$バスターマシン$$s really do use different lines of technology.」

194:t_3:62.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Well... It doesn't use an $$エキゾチックマニューバ$$, so that's only natural.」

194:t_3:63.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then why do they share the name $$バスターマシン$$?」

194:t_3:64.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I think it's like how $$ガンダム$$s exist in various parallel worlds.」

194:t_3:65.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So $$ガンバスター$$ is a $$バスターマシン$$ from a parallel world...」

194:t_3:66.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Given those $$宇宙怪獣$$ we don't recognize, that's probably the sensible conclusion.」

194:t_3:68.en:
$$チコ$$
「Maybe that $$ノリコ$$ girl is a parallel-world version of your beloved $$ノノリリ$$ too...!」

194:t_3:69.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Impossible! Even if she's from a parallel world, she's nothing like $$ノノ$$'s $$ノノリリ$$!」

194:t_3:70.en:
$$ノノ$$
「If that were possible, $$竜馬$$ could be a fresh-faced student in a parallel world!」

194:t_3:71.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...Are we settled for now, $$ノノ$$?」

194:t_3:73.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm sorry. My $$ガンバスター$$ is the $$バスターマシン$$ you've always admired.」

194:t_3:74.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But $$ガンバスター$$ is very precious to me. So please don't say such awful things about it.」

194:t_3:75.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I-I'm sorry, $$ノリコ$$... $$ノノ$$'s heart was tainted...」

194:t_3:76.en:
$$ノノ$$
「When it came to $$バスターマシン$$s and $$ノノリリ$$, $$ノノ$$... $$ノノ$$...」

194:t_3:77.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's all right. ...We're teammates who'll be fighting together in $c now.」

194:t_3:78.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Thank you, $$ノリコ$$! $$ノノ$$ will do her best with hard work and guts too!」

194:t_3:79.en:
$$ラルク$$
「That again... If you rely on that stuff, you'll stay a trainee forever.」

194:t_3:80.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Wait a second, $$ラルク$$. I can't let what you just said slide.」

194:t_3:82.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「There can be no victory without hard work and guts...! Anyone who mocks them will lose to their own weakness in the end!」

194:t_3:84.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノリコ$$ is right, Big Sis...! Hard work and guts are the power that creates hope!」

194:t_3:87.en:
$$チコ$$
「It looks like they hit it off in the end...」

194:t_3:88.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「What's wrong with that? We're all $$バスターマシン$$ pilots from parallel worlds. Let's get along.」

194:t_3:89.en:
$$ニコラ$$
(Yes... We should get along for the sake of what comes next too...)

194:t_3:90.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It seems that's settled for now.」

194:t_3:91.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! From today on, $$ノノ$$ and $$ノリコ$$ are best buddies!」

194:t_3:92.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So once again, I'm looking forward to working with you all.」

194:t_3:94.en:
$$チコ$$
「What...? Are you jealous someone stole your little sister?」

194:t_3:96.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Don't worry, Big Sis! You're $$ノノ$$'s one and only Big Sis!」

194:t_3:98.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「$$ノリコ$$, were you being held in that base too?」

194:t_3:99.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes... I was fighting alongside the Federation forces in the eastern Pacific, but the enemy caught us in a cowardly trap.」

194:t_3:101.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...They put unprotected prisoners on the battlefield to make a human shield.」

194:t_3:103.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「With $$ガンバスター$$'s power, I couldn't attack without hurting those people...」

194:t_3:104.en:
$$カレン$$
「So you had no choice but to surrender.」

194:t_3:105.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「After that, they brought me to this base. $$サイデリアル$$ seemed interested in $$ガンバスター$$ and kept examining it.」

194:t_3:106.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I think they kept me, its pilot, alive because of $$ガンバスター$$ too.」

194:t_3:107.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「By the way, is that provocative outfit to $$サイデリアル$$'s taste?」

194:t_3:108.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「This is the Top Squadron's combat uniform.」

194:t_3:109.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I can keep a spare in the $$バスターマシン$$'s cockpit. I'm glad they didn't confiscate it.」

194:t_3:110.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$ノリコ$$... What was the name of the guy who used that dirty trick...?」

194:t_3:111.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「His name was... $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$.」

194:t_3:113.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It seems most of $c's members have a score to settle with that man.」

194:t_3:114.en:
$$シモン$$
「Then let's all settle it together.」

194:t_3:115.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We'll pay him back double, with plenty of interest.」

194:t_3:117.en:
$$カレン$$
「The capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$... Maybe he and that $$尸空#pilot$$ are both there.」

194:t_3:118.en:
$$甲児$$
「That's what I want...! We'll settle this war with the Empire in one shot!」

194:t_3:121.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Major $$カリーニン$$ has reported on the capital. Naturally, its forces far outstrip those at this $$ターミナル・ベース$$...」

194:t_3:122.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But with our concentrated firepower, we should be able to break through at a single point.」

194:t_3:123.en:
$$甲児$$
「At this point, it's not about the odds. To end the war, we have to risk our lives and crush their leader.」

194:t_3:124.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That's the iron rule of a brawl.」

194:t_3:125.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let's do it. Let's bring peace back to Earth.」

194:t_3:126.en:
$$シモン$$
「...Where's $$ランカ$$, by the way? I heard you rescued her with $$シェリル$$...」

194:t_3:127.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$アルト$$ is with her now. Being held prisoner seems to have been really hard on her.」

194:t_3:128.en:
$$シモン$$
「I see... I'll visit once she's settled down.」

194:t_3:129.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(In the end, I couldn't find out why the Empire is abducting civilians...)

194:t_3:130.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(Why did they take $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$? Was it part of their cultural controls...?)

194:t_3:131.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(And their examination of $$ガンバスター$$... Maybe the Empire is hiding something we still don't know about...)
